title: [finding] the Governed Surface Queue Guard's refusal text tells a seat to dequeue a governed PR by converting it to DRAFT — measured not to dequeue in this repo (same family as #20847)
body:
Filing gate: **① a printed remedy measured false**, with named landing sites.

`reach:` the guard is the required context `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, and it prints this remedy in both refusal branches to every seat whose governed PR reaches the queue without its landing record. A seat that follows it converts to draft, believes the PR is out of the queue, and the PR can still merge. That is the #20695 shape (merged in draft, #20747).

Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat 1 (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, seat post #7623) from the #20847 dev report (out-of-scope finding 2). The seat re-read the lines on `origin/main`. PR #20854 (#20847) corrects the rule text in `AGENTS.md` and `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`; its claim excluded scripts, so the guard's printed text is not in it. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage (the lane table's `domain:skills` row names "governed 面本身的门禁/审计"). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The texts (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` at `origin/main`)

- `:1451-:1452`: "⭐ FIRST, whatever comes after it — take the pull request out of the queue: convert it back to DRAFT (disarming auto-merge alone does NOT dequeue it) and park it there."
- `:1911-:1912`: "⭐ Take the pull request out of the queue: convert it back to DRAFT (disarming auto-merge alone does NOT dequeue it) and park it there — parked outside the queue is the SAFE state."

## Measured

Timelines, re-readable through `GET …/issues/N/timeline`:
- #6732 and #20695: a queued PR converted to draft stayed queued and merged while in draft.
- The #20764 dev's scan: 4 of 4 queued drafts were never removed by the conversion.
- The one measured removal without a red build is a maintainer's manual removal (#20797).

The readings live in `platform-readings.md` (PR #20845). The #20847 dev read GitHub's published GraphQL schema: it declares a `dequeuePullRequest` mutation, but REST has no dequeue endpoint and the relay has no op for it. So no seat-available dequeue act is measured.

## What changes

- Both refusal texts stop saying the draft conversion dequeues. They say what PR #20854's rule says: disable plus draft disarm an unqueued PR; a queued governed PR needs the maintainer's manual removal at once; confirm from the remote.
- The guard's self-test pins its printed text, if it does; the fix moves that pin with it.
- `scripts/pm/**` is not a governed surface, so the PR lands on CI plus the seat's read. The two texts should say the same thing, so land it with or after PR #20854.

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search in this repo, open and closed, for "check-governed-queue-guard refusal text convert back to draft dequeue merge queue": 8 hits.
- #20847 (open) is the rule-text half; it does not touch the script.
- #18083, #19036, #15187, #12750, #18384 and #18020 (all closed) concern the guard's approval, size and path legs or an earlier remedy wording, not the draft-dequeue sentence.
- #12888 (closed) concerns reading queue-ref absence.

Dedupe words: `queue guard refusal draft dequeue` · `check-governed-queue-guard DRAFT dequeue` · `park it there draft`
